def find_best_task_start(n, k, powers):
    min_penalty = float('inf')
    best_task_start = -1
    
    for start in range(n):
        penalty = sum(powers[start:start+k]) + sum(powers[:start % k])
        if penalty < min_penalty:
            min_penalty = penalty
            best_task_start = start + 1
            
    return best_task_start

def min_tell_off_power(n, k, powers):
    total_power = sum(powers)
    max_power = max(powers[:k])
    best_start = 0
    
    current_power = sum(powers[:k])
    for i in range(k, n):
        current_power += powers[i] - powers[i-k]
        if current_power > max_power:
            max_power = current_power
            best_start = i - k + 1
            
    return best_start + 1
